evidence.reason: At current line 85, dict keys are sorted via `k.encode("utf-16be")` without translating `UnicodeEncodeError`. A retained JSON record with a lone-surrogate object key such as `{"\ud800":null}` reaches this call; `retained_loads` catches only `JSONDecodeError`/`UnicodeDecodeError`, and the `_retained_records` skip handler catches only `IntegrityError`, so the encoding error escapes and aborts the scan instead of skipping the corrupt record. This is an ordinary correctness defect in the intended retained-record skip behavior, not merely a hardening proposal.
